FIELDS.NAME: Active Sport Supply
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Store Manager, Active Sport Supply, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Active Sport Supply operates as a retail sporting goods store, specializing in a wide range of non-motorized athletic apparel, footwear, and fitness equipment. Our primary focus is to provide high-quality sporting products to cater to both amateur and professional athletes. We ensure compliance with safety regulations and minimize liability exposure through our robust inventory management system, which guarantees all products meet safety standards and are free from recalls. We conduct seasonal training for our staff on product knowledge and safety protocols, emphasizing the importance of customer safety during equipment use. Active Sport Supply is committed to providing an enjoyable shopping experience while upholding the highest standards of operational safety and product quality.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at our store where $500 worth of merchandise was stolen. The status is currently closed as we have implemented enhanced security measures to prevent future incidents.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B rated safe, UL listed, class 1 vault for cash and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel and fencing installed around the premises to enhance safety and deter theft.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Active Sport Supply does not engage in the storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting of hazardous material, as we focus solely on retailing non-motorized sporting goods. Our operations ensure compliance with safety regulations to minimize any potential liability exposure.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Active Sport Supply does not sponsor athletic teams. Our focus is solely on retailing sporting goods, without involvement in sponsorship activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the store manager or designated compliance officer to ensure compliance with insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Active Sport Supply has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior three years. Our insurance history remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Active Sport Supply does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staffing is managed internally without any employee leasing arrangements.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Active Sport Supply carries Workers Compensation insurance as part of its commitment to employee safety and compliance with legal requirements.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Active Sport Supply does not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on our retail sporting goods operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Active Sport Supply does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. The only policy currently held is the one mentioned in the application.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Active Sport Supply does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as our focus is solely on the retail of non-motorized sporting goods. We prioritize safety and compliance in our operations.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Active Sport Supply does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is solely on retailing non-motorized sporting goods and minimizing potential liability exposure.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Active Sport Supply has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. Our financial history remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Active Sport Supply does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on retailing non-motorized sporting goods. We adhere to safety regulations to minimize any potential liability exposure.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Active Sport Supply does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus solely on retailing non-motorized sporting goods and do not engage in high-risk activities. We maintain a commitment to safety and compliance, further minimizing potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Active Sport Supply has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our commitment to compliance and risk management contributes to a positive operational track record.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Active Sport Supply does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and commitment to operational safety.
